summary: This Form 8-K filed by Silver Point Private Credit Fund reports the issuance and sale of 1,359,664 unregistered common shares for $36.4 million ($26.76 per share) under subscription agreements, along with a declared monthly dividend of $0.1575 per share. The share sale is a routine capital raise exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S, not a special-situation event. The dividend declaration is ordinary course. Neither an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, nor any other special-situation category applies. The filing is a routine capital markets update with no strategic corporate action or governance shakeup.
